verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents its own Filters & Rules feature, and a community user describes setting up a filter view that shows a specific subset of mail. Together these suggest mail can be sorted into separate views, but the pack has only titles and one anecdote, with no description of focused streams or priority-ordered triage. Missing for 10: documented split-inbox or stream views, automatic importance/team/newsletter classification, a dedicated calendar-invite stream, priority-ordered triage, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order

citations.quote: set up a filter on Fastmail showing all mail delivered to the old @gmail.com address in the last two weeks
